articles.title: Red-Eyed, Hairy-Legged Sea Spiders Found in the Salish Sea
articles.summary: Scientists found two brand-new sea spider species in the Salish Sea — the first in almost 100 years. One has hairy legs and bright red eyes. Its mouth looks like a tiny monster pit from a movie!

articles.title: A Dead Star Is Making a Wave That Shouldn't Exist
articles.summary: Astronomers found a giant shock wave around a dead star called RXJ0528+2838. The problem? This star shouldn't be able to make one. It's like finding a bicycle going 300 mph.

articles.title: Scientists Made Old Memories Young Again in Mice
articles.summary: Scientists used a gene therapy to make memory cells in mice act young again. The memories weren't gone — the brain's "hardware" was just too old to reach them. Could this help people one day?
